title: Dal Makhani
summary: Whole urad and kidney beans simmered with tomato, ginger and garlic, enriched with cream and butter, topped with crisp onion tarka.

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Soak
steps.text: Cover the urad and kidney beans with plenty of water and soak overnight, then drain.

steps.title: Boil
steps.text: Boil the kidney beans hard in the 1700 ml water for a full 10 min.

steps.title: Simmer
steps.text: Add the urad, passata, ginger, garlic, cayenne and salt, cover and simmer gently 1½-2 h, stirring now and then and adding water if it gets thick, until the beans are soft and bursting.

steps.title: Enrich
steps.text: Mash about a third of the beans, stir in the cream, garam masala and butter and simmer 10-15 min more until thick and velvety.

steps.title: Tarka
steps.text: Fry the onion in the ghee 5-7 min until crisp and red-gold, then stir in the paprika off the heat.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Spoon the tarka over the dal, swirl with cream and scatter with coriander.

tips: Never skip the 10-minute hard boil for the kidney beans.
Long, gentle cooking makes it creamy.
It tastes even better the next day.
storage: Keep covered in the fridge for up to 3 days; reheat with water until piping hot. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
